content:
**Awareness** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Provides up to +50% V.A.T.S. accuracy based on current Perception. It stacks additively with bonuses provided from Orange Mentats, Nuka-Cola Twist, Eye of the Hunter and V.A.T.S. Enhanced Legendary mod.

| ![FO76 awareness perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/b/b6/FO76_awareness_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Perception | VATS Accuracy | 
| | 1 | +5% | 
| | 15 | +18% | 
| | 30 | +30% | 
| | 60 | +45% | 
| | 100 | +50% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Gain more VATS accuracy based on your PER. | 000D2287 | 

Before Update 58, Awareness showed a target's resistances in V.A.T.S. This effect is now granted by having at least 10 Perception.
